label: 鎧崩し
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame DANGEROUS ACTION 鎧崩し by 魔鎧兵 EXACT 2x2. Ordered: frame1 anticipation, frame2 held windup, frame3 powerful release, frame4 recovery. Trajectory: rectangular shield braces (350,570), sword draws (660,400), straight blade thrusts left (150,580), returns. Shield kept, same sword, planted feet. Exaggerated late-game weight and force, distinct readable poses, secondary cape/tail follows with lag. Body sheet only; tiny attached core/palm glow allowed, full attack VFX separate. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 盾を前へ固め、剣を引いて左へ突き出す。通常の振り下ろしとの姿勢差がある。
issues: 突き出した剣先がセル境界に近い。余白と剣の同一形状を確認する。
盾の持ち手と腕が隠れるため接続を検収する。
